rule: VALID if (a) each positive control (pigmentation, blue-whitish veil) has its target concept with the highest mean TCAV score of the 7 concepts (ties broken by the mean cosine of gradient and CAV), significantly different from random CAVs (Welch t-test, BH-corrected within the 7 concepts, p < 0.05) and above the random mean, in at least 6 of the 8 settings (2 layers x 2 ISIC concept-set variants x 2 input sets; the same share of the available settings), and (b) the largest |TCAV effect| of the permuted-label control (mean over the settings) is below 0.25 x the median of that value over the melanoma classifiers. NOT VALID otherwise. Same structure as the Phase 2 rule; fixed before the Phase 2b run.
